replacements.instruction: Merge the latest main three-run output-length sensitivity wording into the page-fit branch without altering the reviewed main-text cleanup.
replacements.before:
Table~\ref{tab:appendix-length-control} reports pairwise outcomes by output-length ratio.
The longer side wins \LengthLongerRate\ of \LengthLongerNonTie\ non-tied comparisons.
In the tighter pre-specified matching band, the outcomes from the first generation run for our system are \LengthFullSinglePassFiveWLT\ versus \condSinglePass\ ($p=\LengthFullSinglePassFiveP$), \LengthFullTaskPlanningFiveWLT\ versus \condTaskPlanning\ ($p=\LengthFullTaskPlanningFiveP$), and \LengthFullNoGoalsFiveWLT\ versus \condNoGoals.
In the wider pre-specified band, the corresponding outcomes are \LengthFullSinglePassTenWLT\ ($p=\LengthFullSinglePassTenP$), \LengthFullTaskPlanningTenWLT\ ($p=\LengthFullTaskPlanningTenP$), and \LengthFullNoGoalsTenWLT\ ($p=\LengthFullNoGoalsTenP$).
These matching-band $p$-values are unadjusted descriptive sign-test results.
replacements.after:
Table~\ref{tab:appendix-length-control} reports matched-length win rates for our system separately in each of the three generation runs.
Within the tighter pre-specified matching band, our system is favored over \condSinglePass\ in every run, remains above parity against \condTaskPlanning\ while narrowing toward parity, and changes direction across runs against \condNoGoals.
The wider pre-specified band shows the same qualitative pattern.
These matching-band results are descriptive sensitivity checks; ties are excluded from the win-rate denominator, and generation runs are reported separately because they reuse the same prompts.
